title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (PSX) - Hip Hop Disco (Boss)
description:
The BG is seen in the battle with Judy and Melora in Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius for the PSX. Ripped the BG via screenshot and used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting Feature. I placed the animation tiles near the other ones that require animation and used 1 slot for the whole thing.

Uses the second half of palette row 4.

Credit not needed. Have fun!
